name: Other Spheres
source:
Callisto is on a long-term deep-sea research dive, with only the sea, cherished memories, and an irascible on-board AI for company.  But while they adore the sea, it turns out the sea might reciprocate the feeling—and in ways Callisto isn't prepared for.

[From [url=https://butterflyrocket.itch.io/other-spheres]itch.io[/url]]
